items.title: Eddie Metz Jr. interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, October 3, 2015
items.q: Like Steely Dan — love Steely Dan — I love that band — you never know who’s going to play warm-up for them. ... Because Donald Fagan heard them playing in a bar somewhere in Chicago.

ctx.x: Yeah. The bean counters. This is wasted time. Make them fold shirts or something. And they did. They had a couple of managers do that. So I survived Disney for 15 years doing all kinds of different jobs and also working on the outside. And my last few years there was when I really started doing jazz parties and festivals, either as a solo, just a drummer that they invite to the jazz party, or I was working with a band called the Black Dogs which is a great, great Dixieland band. Best band I ever worked with. It…
